name: Machine Hall
desc: A Victorian engine hall receding into its own soot — rank after rank of mill engines turning their great spoked flywheels, connecting rods driving crossheads into cylinders, belts running up to a line shaft under the roof trusses, and dust turning slowly in the clerestory light four planes deep.

energy.doc: engine speed + glow + how far the hall parallaxes

scale.doc: hall size — 2.0 puts you down among the flywheels, 0.5 is a distant vista

density.doc: engines per rank (2..4 near, more with depth) and dust

speed.doc: line-shaft rpm — every engine is geared off it at its own ratio

hue.doc: the hall's tint — gaslight amber by default; push cold for a dead works

x.doc: which way you are facing down the hall

y.doc: eye level — the horizon the whole hall converges on

haze.doc: atmospheric density between the four depth planes

anno.doc: engraved detail: floor hatching, column fluting, plate border and annotation

style.doc: aesthetic: sooty gaslit chiaroscuro / aged engraved Admiralty plate / prussian cyanotype / additive x-ray ghost / schematic (the hall reduces to bare kinematic circles and lines)

seed.doc: engine placement, sizes, gear ratios, rotation senses

alpha.doc: opacity of everything above the tonal ground
